supportedClaims: Persisted MBQC pattern evidence with independent command/causal-domain replay, branch normalization, gate-model state and adaptive byproduct verification (<=10 logical/live qubits) and central Acceptance.
outOfScope: Exhaustive verification across all measurement branches or arbitrary-input quantum channel equivalence; hardware noise or resource-optimality claims.
Independent statevector and adaptive pattern replay when simulate=false, referenceMode=skip or beyond 10 logical/live qubits, 512 gates or 4096 commands.

checks.criterion: Persisted MBQC request satisfies its JSON Schema and bounded circuit/seed contract.
Persisted MBQC result satisfies its JSON Schema.
Recompute preparations, graph edges, measurements, causal X/Z domains, outputs and peak live space.
Every branch binds its seed, output dimension and exactly one outcome per measured node.
Reported simulation and reference policy bind to input.
Every simulated branch statevector is normalized and matches its reported normError.
When simulated within <=10 logical/live qubits and reference enabled, every sampled branch matches the independent gate-model state, Born probabilities and reported fidelity.
When simulated within <=10 logical/live qubits and reference enabled, independent adaptive XY projections and X/Z byproduct corrections reproduce every sampled branch statevector.
When the Tool reports a computed gate-model reference, its reference statevector and worst branch infidelity match independent recomputation.
Every performed independent check is non-failing; optional reference availability cannot hide a scientific contradiction.
Actual re-read canonical input and artifact bytes match their digests and actual Harness event range.
